subject: SOC2 evidence & SSO walkthrough — coordinate tech session

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iy@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence & SSO walkthrough — coordinate tech session

Hi Sarah / NovaPay security team,

Thanks again for taking time to evaluate Redwood for your payments stack. Per our conversation last week, the next step is a technical deep-dive focused on two things: (1) architecture and SSO integration points; and (2) SOC 2 evidence / audit log requirements so your compliance team can validate our controls.

Proposed agenda (45–60m total):
- 20m: high-level architecture (runtime, data flows, encryption at rest/in transit)
- 15m: SSO/SAML/OIDC setup and metadata exchange
- 20m: SOC 2 evidence intake (log retention, access controls, KMS/HSM, redaction)
- 10m: Q&A / follow-ups / next steps

Can you share 3 windows that work on your side next week? We’ll loop in our security lead (Neha) and solutions engineer (Marissa) to be on the call. I’m in PDT; if you give times I’ll propose slots in your TZ.

I’ve attached a short evidence request matrix (SOC2_evidence_request.xlsx) so you know what to expect. Also attaching a draft attendee list — feel free to add additional reviewers.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Available windows next week (ET):
- Tue 2026-05-26 10:00–11:00 ET
- Wed 2026-05-27 14:00–15:00 ET
- Thu 2026-05-28 09:00–10:00 ET

We’ll likely have 4 people from NovaPay on the call: myself, our Head of Compliance (Priya Agarwal), one infra engineer (Ethan Cho), and a product reviewer. I attached our attendee contact list.

If you can confirm a time, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short list of pre-reads.

Cheers,

- Can Neha lead the SOC 2 evidence section (20m) and outline the specific artifacts we can surface (SOC 2 report, control narratives, auth logs)? We should be explicit about what we cannot provide (raw customer traffic by default) and how we can provide redacted logs or aggregated audit exports.
